title: Storm Secrets
subtitle: Lore, loot, wild true stories and a vault to crack
version_note: Game details from Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), Fortnitemares update v42.30, as of 12 October 2026. Real-world facts checked October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book: the latest lore and loot, pro tips, wild true stories, and a quest in every chapter to crack Geno's 13-letter vault code. Answers are always on the next page.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Drop in this book, from A to Z. Try dropping one into a conversation this week. Bonus points if it's in the lobby.

chapters.title: Previously, on the Island
chapters.toc: The story so far, and the newest weapons
chapters.dek: A villain hacking reality, a cursed cartridge, a gun that ties balloons to people and a pumpkin you can ride. Here's what's going on.

chapters.title: The Perfect Drop
chapters.toc: Where to land, and the first daredevils
chapters.dek: Hot drop or quiet drop? Plus the banana question, a hammer on the Moon and the first person to jump with a parachute.

chapters.title: Why the Storm Cheats
chapters.dek: The circle gets half as wide, but three-quarters of your space vanishes. Here's the trick, and how the pros beat it.

chapters.title: Heal Like a Pro
chapters.toc: Every heal, and the heal-order secret
chapters.dek: Matches are won by the player who heals best. Here's every heal on the Island, and the order secret pros swear by.

chapters.title: The Blocks That Flattened a Town
chapters.toc: Falling blocks and the game made of brackets
chapters.dek: Giant blocks squashed a whole town. They came from a game invented on a computer that couldn't draw pictures.

chapters.title: Faster Than Sound
chapters.toc: Rings, speed and a very important broom
chapters.dek: Golden Rings, the fastest ways around the Island, and the pilot who broke the sound barrier with a broomstick.

chapters.title: How the Ghosts Think
chapters.toc: Ghost rules and the Robot Llama
chapters.dek: The ghosts seem to have personalities. They don't. Learn their rules, then program a robot llama of your own.

chapters.title: Builds That Never Break
chapters.toc: The box, the triangle and the Coathanger
chapters.dek: Box up like a pro, find out why triangles never wobble, and meet the man who cut the Harbour Bridge ribbon on horseback.

chapters.title: Callouts Like a Pro
chapters.toc: Grid callouts, map gossip and a map that fibs
chapters.dek: "Enemy at D5!" Make perfect callouts, catch up on the map gossip, and spot the world map that's been fibbing for 450 years.

chapters.title: Crack the Vault
chapters.toc: Vault keys, Caesar's cipher and Morse code
chapters.dek: How to open the Island's vaults, crack a Roman general's secret code, and beat Geno's three-digit lock.

chapters.title: Real-Life Sprites
chapters.toc: The best Sprites, and real animal superpowers
chapters.dek: The Sprites worth hunting, the new one that throws bees, and real animals with powers just as wild.

chapters.title: Don't Get Played
chapters.toc: Shop smarts, sneaky adverts and scams
chapters.dek: The Item Shop is designed to make you want things. Here's how to spot the tricks and never get scammed.

chapters.title: Is Your Lucky Skin Actually Lucky?
chapters.toc: Lucky skins, cartridge myths and real or fake
chapters.dek: Does blowing into a game cartridge fix it? Does a lucky outfit help you win? Here's how to find out.

chapters.title: How the Champions Really Won
chapters.toc: The two-point world final, and sneaky charts
chapters.dek: The world final was won by two points, and the winners didn't get the most eliminations. Here's their secret.

chapters.title: Open the Vault
chapters.dek: Thirteen letters. One vault. Time to find out what Geno's been hiding.

chapters.toc: Every Word Drop, A to Z
